paths.finding: Signed source ID, bounded body, signature and event-schema validation precede ingress persistence.
Weighted linked opportunity targets append evaluationStatements in the same D1 batch; replay returns the existing identity.
All evaluation-producing writes are open-lifecycle guarded; SQL decay horizon is 30 days and bands use 40 and 70 thresholds.
Authenticated detail reads the persisted evaluation, policy identity, timestamp and contribution list.
Native PATCH retains other values and routes through ordinary Records save.
Opportunity fields and association changes append evaluationStatements; value and expected-close edits are executed by the frozen journey.
Native stage moves queue mutationJob; app Records middleware drains it before successful response returns.
Base session and same-origin write guards; processEvaluationJobs wraps successful Records mutations, not the separate relationships route.
Native People association save commits relationships and stale-draft statements but contains no evaluationStatements or mutationJob.
Relationship snapshot and actor fences guard atomic association saves. commitRelationships only executes the supplied statements.
People saves PUT relationships/opportunity/<id>; ordinary editable fields PATCH records/opportunity/<id>.
Remove from deal changes the saved stakeholder set through the separate relationship save.
Actual emitted opportunity page composes native field autosave and People context autosave.
